scope: Four review repairs. Execution advancement remains Product lifecycle-owned; frozen projection preparation/encoding remains Product-owned; Bridge only transports identity/state/bytes; Renderer only requests consumer scopes and maintains ephemeral reading/panel state. No merge, SDK patch, new worker, second transport, persisted format change or event-pump limit change.

fixtures.full: 50 Tasks x 16 Runs x 32 Tools; 16 Manual and 34 Automatic Workspaces
fixtures.escaped_history: legal shared allocation filled with worst JSON-escape text
fixtures.tool_inputs: Bash inputs with the same maximum Task/Run/Tool and shared allocation limits
fixtures.tool_results: 256 valid Bash result JSON values, each stdout 640 newlines, selected in the latest/history windows
fixtures.concentrated_results: 1 Task x 1 Run x 32 Tools; 5 failed Bash Tools each have valid near-128KiB JSON input and result (65,000 decoded newlines per command/stdout), remainder uses the real shared text allocation budget
fixtures.fixture_legality: all four fixtures encode successfully under the canonical Task persistence contract before timing; shared budget remains full and every field stays within its own limit
fixtures.structured_result_path: untimed assertion proves command and stdout are actually decoded by the production formatter, rather than unavailable fallback
fixtures.management_load: skills/mcp/schedules consumer ranges on the configured fixture; not a maximum management-catalog benchmark

performance_contract.metric: For each read, the maximum continuous begin, preparation or encode+cache+transport step, then P99/max over 100 reads. Individual stage metrics are also recorded. Fixture setup/invalidation and structural-path assertions are outside the timed steps. Both modes measured separately after compilation, with no concurrent test/build jobs.
performance_contract.allocator: Existing std.testing allocator retained; no affinity/priority pinning, sample removal or threshold relaxation.
performance_contract.preparation: One bounded formatter-stage batch charged against frozen raw source size, at most four completed small Tools or one oversized stage; a large JSON parse is separated from other parses of the same Tool.

gate_status: Debug P99 passed for every case, but one maximum wall step exceeded the unchanged 32 ms limit. ReleaseFast passed all original gates. No sample removed; no acceptance rule changed. User clarification pending. Final DAG review and parent goal remain open.

renderer_followup.scope: UI-only reclamation of confirmed deleted reading/disclosure identities. The desktop stress artifact predates this follow-up; no new native or transport behavior.

limits: This is a partial measurement record, not final acceptance. The original maximum wall-clock gate is still unmet and has not been weakened.
